unsupported: Freudenberg Medical is headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota, and operates as part of the Freudenberg Group, a family-owned enterprise with more than 175 years of experience developing high-performance materials.
The medical division focuses exclusively on contract development and manufacturing for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries.

Freudenberg Medical serves medical device and biopharma customers globally, with recent expansions adding catheter manufacturing capacity in Jeffersonville, Indiana, and Galway, Ireland, as well as high-volume thermoplastic extrusion in Coyol, Costa Rica.
